summary.text: Complete applications, including a schedule of assets, can typically be processed in less than 3 months.

details.heading: Typical processing time
details.body: Complete applications, which include a schedule of assets, can typically be processed in less than 3 months.

details.heading: What can affect the timing
details.body: The timing depends on the Court’s calendar, the applicant’s personal schedule, the time taken to swear or affirm the Supporting Affidavit and Administration Oath, and the time taken to verify the original will at the Probate registry.
